q: 各國 8 月的每日平均 DAU，由高到低
sql:
SELECT c.country_name, ROUND(AVG(t.dau), 0) AS avg_daily_dau FROM (
  SELECT date, country_code, SUM(dau) AS dau FROM daily_app_metrics
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY date, country_code) t
JOIN countries c USING (country_code) GROUP BY c.country_name ORDER BY avg_daily_dau DESC
answer: 台灣每日平均 DAU 為 10,345，日本為 7,273，美國為 6,201，為各國 8 月每日平均 DAU 最高前三名。

q: 各 App 上半年的 iOS 營收
sql: SELECT a.app_name, ROUND(SUM(d.revenue_usd), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM daily_app_metrics d JOIN apps a ON d.app_id = a.app_id WHERE d.platform = 'iOS' AND d.date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY a.app_name ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC
answer: 各 App 上半年的 iOS 營收分別為：星芽健身 28,745.07 USD，芽芽記帳 27,190.54 USD，芽語單字 16,209.03 USD，星芽相機 1,193.62 USD。

q: 哪個 App 上個月的 D1 留存率最高？
sql: SELECT a.app_name, ROUND(SUM(r.d1_retained) / SUM(r.cohort_size), 4) AS d1_retention_rate FROM retention r JOIN apps a ON r.app_id = a.app_id WHERE r.cohort_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY a.app_name ORDER BY d1_retention_rate DESC LIMIT 1
answer: 上個月芽語單字的 D1 留存率為 0%。
